entry.title: PKM vs RAG vs Wiki vs Memory Systems Explained Clearly
entry.summary: PKM, RAG, wikis, and AI memory systems are often discussed as if they solve the same problem. They do not. They all deal with knowledge, but they operate at different layers: PKM helps humans think. Wikis help groups preserve shared knowledge. RAG helps machines retrieve external knowledge. Memory systems help AI agents persist context over time. Confusing these systems leads to bad architecture.
